title: Zephyr: SF Assignment and gateway DIO option
description: Implement ASSIGNED_SF RPL DIO option, per-SF node tracking, gateway load balancing
close_reason: Implemented Zephyr SF Assignment: Added LICHEN_RPL_OPT_ASSIGNED_SF (0x14) option type and build/parse functions to rpl_messages.h/c. Added lichen_sf_tracker struct with per-SF node tracking and load-balancing (sf_tracker_assign/least_loaded). Modified rpl_root.c to include ASSIGNED_SF option in DIO broadcasts. Aligns with Rust/Python implementations and spec 02-physical-link.md section 3.4.
